## TemplateEngine.\_processBaseBlocks() method

Block: base Extracts and parses `<base>` blocks from a template string.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _processBaseBlocks(template: string): {
        [baseId: string]: string;
    };
```

**Returns:**

An object mapping base IDs to their cleaned inner content

## Remarks

This internal method identifies all `<base>` blocks in the template and extracts their content, organizing them by their `id` attribute. Blocks without an `id` are stored under the key `"default"`<!-- -->. Leading whitespace and surrounding newlines are trimmed from the inner content.

\*\*Attributes:\*\* - `id` (optional): Identifier for the base block. If not specified, defaults to `"default"`<!-- -->. Used to reference specific base blocks when compiling templates or extracting content.

## Example


```typescript
const template = `
  <base id="main">
    <message>Hello World</message>
  </base>
  <base id="error">
    <message>Error occurred</message>
  </base>
  <base>
    <message>Default block</message>
  </base>
`;
const bases = TemplateEngine._processBaseBlocks(template);
// Result: {
//   main: '<message>Hello World</message>',
//   error: '<message>Error occurred</message>',
//   default: '<message>Default block</message>'
// }
```
